automationNotes: Steps mirror the doc in order. Section 1 (Retrieve Credentials from Optimizely) navigates to Optimizely — all external-site steps are warnOnly (skipped until real credentials are available; remove warnOnly once credentials are set). Project ID and Access Token are captured via {{OPT_PROJECT_ID}} and {{OPT_ACCESS_TOKEN}}. Section 2 (Install and Configure) follows the standard Marketplace install pattern with position checks (App Switcher top-right, Content Models left nav, Profile bottom-left). Section 3 (Use) creates 'Optimizely Test Content Type' with two Custom fields (Audience + Variations, including Display Name/Help Text/Instruction Value), creates an entry, exercises audience checkbox selection, then demonstrates BOTH Experiment and Campaign variation paths — all warnOnly since real Optimizely credentials are required for widget data.

steps.target: https://app.optimizely.com/signin
steps.note: Change action to 'navigate' and remove warnOnly from all Section 1 steps once Optimizely credentials are available
